Apple is developing the second-generation iPhone Air, which is expected to address several major limitations of the current model. Here are the latest updates on the iPhone Air 2's specifications, release date, and other known details.

Will there be an iPhone Air 2?

Reports indicate that iPhone Air sales have fallen short of Apple's expectations. In November, The Information reported that Apple has indefinitely postponed the launch of the second-generation model due to lower-than-expected sales.

Apple reportedly "has notified engineers and suppliers to remove the next iPhone Air from the production schedule, but has not provided a new launch date."

However, shortly after, The Information updated its report, stating that Apple has not completely cancelled the iPhone Air 2, and the model is still under active development.

iPhone Air 2 Features

Addition of a second camera

One of the biggest trade-offs of the iPhone Air's ultra-thin design is that it only has one camera. Reports indicate that Apple is actively working to change this with the iPhone Air 2.

According to sources such as Bloomberg and The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a second camera on the back.

Bloomberg says it will be an ultra-wide lens rather than a telephoto lens. This will align the configuration with Apple's base model iPhone, which also features a main camera paired with an ultra-wide lens.

A20 Pro chip

Reports indicate that the iPhone Air 2 will be equipped with the A20 Pro processor, a step up from the A19 Pro used in the current model.

The A20 Pro will be Apple's first iPhone processor manufactured using a 2-nanometer process. This new process will allow the A20 Pro to deliver greater performance and improved energy efficiency within a similar chip area.

The chip will also adopt another new technology called Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WLCSP), which integrates the SoC and DRAM at the wafer level to boost performance and reduce power consumption.

Improved battery life

Reports indicate that Apple is also working to improve the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

According to supply chain sources, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a 3,500mAh battery. For comparison, the first-generation iPhone Air has a battery capacity of 3,149mAh, representing an increase of more than 10%.

In addition to increasing the physical battery capacity, the performance improvements of the A20 Pro chip are also expected to further extend the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

However, it should be noted that there are many factors that affect iPhone battery life. We'll have to wait until Apple officially announces the iPhone Air 2 to know the actual figures.

Vapor chamber cooling

According to The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a vapor chamber cooling system. Apple previously introduced vapor chamber cooling technology in the iPhone 17 Pro, claiming it significantly improves thermal performance and efficiency.

If Apple introduces vapor chamber technology to the iPhone Air 2, the device will be able to maintain lower temperatures during high-load operation and sustain high-performance output for longer periods.

iPhone Air 2: Release Date

The iPhone Air 2 was originally expected to launch in September 2026, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series.

However, recent reports from Bloomberg indicate that Apple plans to delay the iPhone Air 2 until spring 2027, releasing it alongside the new base model iPhone 18.

What do you think of Apple's plans for the iPhone Air 2? Are these changes and improvements heading in the right direction? Let us know your thoughts in the comments section.
